<h2>Build a Pipeline Progress Monitor Server</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Builds the Shiny server function used by the targets progress monitor.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_pipeline_progress_monitor_server(
  monitor_id,
  path_monitor_config,
  flag_refresh_automatically
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="monitor_id">monitor_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single character string identifying the targets watch module.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="path_monitor_config">path_monitor_config</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the temporary targets configuration file.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="flag_refresh_automatically">flag_refresh_automatically</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical indicating whether automatic refresh remains enabled at startup.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A Shiny server function.
</p>

</main>
